clips.title: The story
paras: At the Southern Guard Tower, Mountaineer Wallbang calls travelers to help defend Loch Modan from the Stonesplinter troggs. With Ironforge's reserves sent to distant fronts, the southern pass is thinly held. Wallbang sends seasoned recruits into Stonesplinter Valley to strike at the clan's shamans and bonesnappers.

Loch Modan's defenses are stretched thin. Ironforge's regular reserves have been summoned to distant fronts across Azeroth, leaving outposts such as the Southern Guard Tower short-handed. Mountaineer Wallbang and his few comrades face constant pressure from the Stonesplinter clan. They depend on Alliance travelers passing through to help hold the southern pass.

The fighting reaches beyond stray scouts to the Stonesplinter clan's strength. Its bonesnappers provide brutal force, while its shamans use earthen magic to rally their kin. Slaying twenty of these targets weakens the clan's incursions into the lowlands and serves King Magni Bronzebeard's defense of the realm.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Mountaineers tell me you are quite brave and capable, friend. We need a traveler like you around here. The Trogg problem isn't getting any better. The reserves have been called to the front and we're all alone out here. But now that we have a seasoned adventurer here, let's see what you can do.
Go out and kill 10 Stonesplinter Shaman and 10 Stonesplinter Bonesnappers. Let's see if you live up to your reputation, Trogg-Slayer.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Back so soon? In case I didn't make myself clear we need you to kill 10 Stonesplinter Shaman and 10 Stonesplinter Bonesnappers, Friend. Now go get 'em, Trogg-Slayer!

clips.title: Completion
paras: I knew the second I laid eyes on you, friend, that you would make Ironforge proud. You have served King Magni well. Now that you've proven yourself to be such a loyal aid to the Kingdom, perhaps you should talk with the Captain to see if he'll entrust you with a higher detail.
